set.body:
Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-18-best-recall-to-video-mapper.md §1 FilmFestival stimulus material, §5 item 6.

Eight FilmFestival films plus the cartoon are local and checksum-verified (data/filmfestival/media). The two commercial excerpts (cover names catch_me_if_you_can and the_prisoner) are absent; the Trillium manifest marks them 'Brad supplying'. All three coders' annotations fix their boundaries. catch_me_if_you_can (346 s): from the 'Inspired by a true story' card through the game-show cold open and the Marseille prison scene to 'Okay Carl... let's go home' as the Rotary Club voice-over begins; whether an animated title sequence was cut is unknown. the_prisoner (260 s): from the cafe ('We'll be with you in a minute') to his exit from the general store after 'Be seeing you' -- mid-episode, not the opening; the Trillium manifest's 'first 4.3 min' is wrong.

Scope:
Place source files for the two excerpts; decide whether Memento media is wanted for track T4.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Files placed in data/filmfestival/media/source as catch_me_if_you_can.* and the_prisoner.* (ignored, not committed).
2. Clips cut to the annotation boundaries have durations of 346 s and 260 s within 0.5 s; the animated-credits question is answered with frame or dialogue timestamps recorded in a note here.
3. The FilmFestival hash manifest is updated to include both.
4. Memento: a recorded yes/no on acquiring media for T4.

Gate: the owner's decision is recorded verbatim, or faithfully summarized and confirmed by the
owner, as a decision note on this bead.

Size: S (owner).
set.title: OWNER: supply the Catch Me If You Can and The Prisoner excerpts (and Memento media if T4 is wanted there)
